videos.title: Why Ireland Is So Vulnerable to Russian Threats | WSJ
videos.description:

videos.title: How Burger King’s New Whopper Is Winning Back Customers | WSJ
videos.description:
Burger King is trying to convince America it has the best burger out—and that it’s worth paying for. The No. 2 U.S. burger chain by sales has charged its corporate chef with upgrading the sauces, buns and packaging for its food. Executives believe the improvements are helping it to stand out in the competitive fast-food market that often relies on discounts to bring in customers. But they are also having to convince restaurant operators that the changes are worth the investment even at a time when food costs are rising.

WSJ goes inside Burger King’s test kitchen at the company’s Miami headquarters and speaks with executives about how they’re seeking to gain more sales through juicier chicken nuggets and hotter Whoppers.

videos.title: How Meta Will Enforce New Age And Time Limits On Instagram And Facebook
videos.description:
Meta has agreed to pay up to $17 billion and make sweeping changes to Instagram and Facebook as part of a landmark child safety settlement with nearly every U.S. state. The deal introduces new protections for teens, including time limits, overnight blocks and stronger age verification, changes that could fundamentally alter how young people use Meta’s platforms. But implementing those safeguards, particularly determining users’ ages, presents major technical and business challenges. CNBC’s Julia Boorstin examines how Meta plans to pull it off, and why the settlement could ultimately force changes across TikTok, YouTube and the rest of the social media industry.

videos.title: Anthropic’s Distillation Battle Turns To The Dark Web As China Concerns Swell
videos.description:
Foreign companies have allegedly been accessing American AI systems to train competing technology — a process called distillation — and selling copycat versions at a lower price. Anthropic is trying to crack down on what it says are illegal practices that involve use of the dark web and intellectual property theft. Jacob Klein, Anthropic's head of threat intelligence, says, "there's an entire illicit ecosystem to try to gain access to Claude and other models.” CNBC's Kate Rooney has the story.

videos.title: Unlocking Job Creation in Fragile Settings | You Ask, We Answer
videos.description:
Private investment is essential to creating jobs, rebuilding infrastructure, and supporting businesses in countries affected by fragility, conflict, and violence (FCV). But what does it take to attract investment in some of the world's most challenging markets?

In this edition of You Ask, We Answer, World Bank Group experts answer questions from audiences around the world about the challenges and opportunities of investing in fragile and conflict-affected economies.

Drawing on real projects and practical experience, they will discuss how financing, guarantees, and partnerships can help address the risks that hold investors back—and how the public and private sectors can work together to create jobs and economic opportunities.

Watch the replay and find additional resources in the chat to learn how the World Bank Group helps mobilize private investment in fragile and conflict-affected settings.

videos.title: Crypto Bet Big On U.S. Regulation, And Now Its Landmark Legislation Hangs In The Balance
videos.description:
The crypto industry's biggest legislative bet is being put to the test as Congress prepares to return from its August recess. Lobbyists and lawmakers are sifting through the Clarity Act in hopes of passing the comprehensive crypto rulebook before the midterm elections. But the industry is signaling waning confidence that the bill will pass, and is instead looking to other agencies like the SEC and CFTC to regulate the industry without Clarity.

videos.title: Supporting Rohingya and Host Communities in Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh
videos.description:
Since 2017, more than one million Rohingya have taken shelter in Cox’s Bazar in Bangladesh, placing pressure on local services and infrastructure. The World Bank is helping provide essential services for displaced Rohingya people and host communities—from water, sanitation, health and nutrition to food security, safety, protection, and resilience. These efforts are helping improve daily life, strengthen resilience, and support dignity for displaced Rohingya until the safe and voluntary return and the host community.

videos.title: How Better Roads Are Transforming Communities in Laos
videos.description:
The World Bank Southeast Asia Regional Economic Corridor and Connectivity Project is upgrading an Asian Highway and streamlining border procedures to increase job opportunities through better connectivity across Thailand, the Lao PDR, and Viet Nam. In northern Laos, the project is revitalizing communities by improving secondary roads that connect to rural villages, improving road safety, and increasing access to markets, public services, and opportunities.

هل ترغب بالعمل مع مجموعة البنك الدولي بدون الحاجة إلى التقديم لوظيفة؟ اكتشف كيفية العثور على مشاريع المشتريات والعقود المربحة التي تقدمها مجموعة البنك الدولي، والمشاركة في المناقصات، والفوز بها.
يمكنك الوصول إلى الأدوات والإرشادات والتنبيهات على منصة البنك الدولي الخاصة بالموردين: http://wrld.bg/YG1v50Z4Ul7 من خلال منصة مجموعة البنك الدولي للموردين، تستطيع الشركات من جميع الأحجام الحصول على تمويل بمليارات الدولارات لمشاريع عالمية. يشرح هذا الفيديو كيفية إيجاد فرص التوريد، والتعامل مع منهجية التوريد المُحدَّثة، والمنافسة بنزاهة على العقود في مجالات السلع والأعمال والخدمات. مع أكثر من 1600 مشروع نشط في أكثر من 100 دولة، تشمل المشتريات الممولة من البنك الدولي ما يلي: الأعمال المدنية والمعدات أنظمة تكنولوجيا المعلومات والاستشارات خدمات فنية متخصصة للشركات الصغيرة والمتوسطة والشركات العالمية ما الجديد في هذا الإطار المُحدَّث؟ يركز النظام الجديد على أفضل قيمة (وليس مجرد أفضل سعر)، والمشاركة المبكرة في السوق، وخيارات دفع أفضل، ونظام شكاوى قوي لضمان عملية اختيار عادلة وشفافة. تعرّف على المزيد وسجّل عملك اليوم: http://wrld.bg/YG1v50Z4Ul7
